# Setup

```{r packages}
load_or_install_packages <- function(packages) {
  # BiocManager is needed to install Bioconductor packages
  if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("BiocManager")
  }

  for (pck in packages) {
    if (!require(pck, character.only = TRUE)) {
      message("Installing: ", pck)
      BiocManager::install(pck, update = FALSE, ask = FALSE)
      library(pck, character.only = TRUE)
    } else {
      message("Package already installed; loading: ", pck)
    }
  }
}

load_or_install_packages(c("TCGAbiolinks", "SummarizedExperiment", "dplyr"))
```


```{r folders}
project_specifier <- "TCGA-PRAD"

# Folders
root_dir <- getwd()
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data")
target_download_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "GDCdata")
image_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "images")

# Create if non existent
for (directory in c(data_dir, target_download_dir, image_dir)) {
  if (!dir.exists(directory)) {
    dir.create(directory, recursive = TRUE)
  }
}
```



# Get GDC Data

```{r load_or_download_function}
download_or_load_tcga_expression <- function(project, sample_type, file_label,
                                             download_directory, save_directory,
                                             force = FALSE) {

  rda_file_path <- file.path(save_directory,
                             paste0(project, "_", file_label, "_SummarizedExperiment.rda"))

  # If cached -> load cache
  if (file.exists(rda_file_path) && !force) {
    message("Loading cached object: ", rda_file_path)
    loaded_object_names <- load(rda_file_path)   # GDCprepare stores the object as `data`
    return(get(loaded_object_names[1]))
  }

  # 1) Build the query
  gdc_query <- TCGAbiolinks::GDCquery(
    project       = project,
    data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
    data.type     = "Gene Expression Quantification",
    workflow.type = "STAR - Counts",
    sample.type   = sample_type
  )

  # 2) Download the data (files already on disk are skipped -> re-running resumes)
  TCGAbiolinks::GDCdownload(
    query           = gdc_query,
    directory       = download_directory,
    method          = "api",
    files.per.chunk = 15
  )

  # 3) Prepare the data and save it as cache
  TCGAbiolinks::GDCprepare(
    query                = gdc_query,
    directory            = download_directory,
    summarizedExperiment = TRUE,
    save                 = TRUE,
    save.filename        = rda_file_path
  )
}
```


```{r get_cancer_tissue_data}
cancerTissue_data <- download_or_load_tcga_expression(
  project            = project_specifier,
  sample_type        = "Primary Tumor",
  file_label         = "cancerTissue",
  download_directory = target_download_dir,
  save_directory     = data_dir
)

SummarizedExperiment::assayNames(cancerTissue_data)

# Raw "unstranded" counts -> TCGA did not preserve strand information
# (= no information on which DNA strand a read came from),
# so reads are counted regardless of strand
cancerTissue_geneExpression_data <-
  SummarizedExperiment::assay(cancerTissue_data, "unstranded")
dim(cancerTissue_geneExpression_data)
```


```{r get_normal_tissue_data}
normalTissue_data <- download_or_load_tcga_expression(
  project            = project_specifier,
  sample_type        = "Solid Tissue Normal",
  file_label         = "normalTissue",
  download_directory = target_download_dir,
  save_directory     = data_dir
)

normalTissue_geneExpression_data <-
  SummarizedExperiment::assay(normalTissue_data, "unstranded")
dim(normalTissue_geneExpression_data)
```


```{r get_clinical_data}

clinical_patient_data <- TCGAbiolinks::GDCquery_clinic(
  project = project_specifier,

)

```




# Gene Expression Data Cleaning and Preparation

## Get Gene Annotation

Row names are versioned Ensembl IDs (e.g. `ENSG00000141510.18`).
`rowData` also provides gene symbol and gene type, kept as a lookup table.

```{r gene_annotation}
gene_annotation <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::rowData(cancerTissue_data))
gene_annotation <- gene_annotation[, intersect(c("gene_id", "gene_name", "gene_type"),
                                               colnames(gene_annotation)), drop = FALSE]
head(gene_annotation)
table(gene_annotation$gene_type) %>% sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>% head(10)
```



## Common Genes

Restrict tumor and normal matrices to the same set of genes.

```{r identify_common_genes}
common_gene_ids <- intersect(
  rownames(cancerTissue_geneExpression_data),
  rownames(normalTissue_geneExpression_data)
)

cancer_expression_common_genes <- cancerTissue_geneExpression_data[common_gene_ids,
                                                                   , drop = FALSE]
normal_expression_common_genes <- normalTissue_geneExpression_data[common_gene_ids,
                                                                   , drop = FALSE]
```



## Deduplication

Each TCGA barcode encodes biospecimen metadata, e.g. "TCGA-HC-7740-01A-11R-2118-07":

- 1–12 = patient ID ("TCGA-HC-7740")
  - TCGA = project
  - HC = tissue source site (collecting hospital)
  - 7740 = participant
- 14–16 = sample type + vial ("01A")
  - sample type: "01" primary tumor, "11" solid tissue normal (01–09 tumor, 10–19 normal)
  - vial: "A", "B", … = aliquots of the same sample
- 18–20 = portion + analyte ("11R" -> "R" = RNA)
- 22–25 = plate ("2118") -> sequencing batch
- 27–28 = sequencing center ("07")

Some patients have several aliquots of the same tissue. These would not be independent observations.
Thus, only one sample per patient and tissue is retained. The one to keep is selected by lowest vial first ("01A" > "01B") and then highest sequencing depth (= library size).


```{r deduplicate_patients}

deduplicate_tcga_expression_matrix <- function(expression_matrix, tissue_label,
                                               condition_label) {

  cat("\n--- Processing:", tissue_label, "---\n")

  sample_metadata_table <- TCGAbiolinks::get_IDs(expression_matrix)

  sample_metadata_table$barcode      <- as.character(colnames(expression_matrix))
  sample_metadata_table$patient      <- substr(sample_metadata_table$barcode, 1, 12)
  sample_metadata_table$sample_vial  <- substr(sample_metadata_table$barcode, 14, 16)
  sample_metadata_table$condition    <- condition_label
  sample_metadata_table$library_size <- colSums(expression_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Inspect duplicate patients
  duplicated_patient_ids <- unique(
    sample_metadata_table$patient[duplicated(sample_metadata_table$patient)]
  )

  if (length(duplicated_patient_ids) > 0) {
    cat("Found", length(duplicated_patient_ids), "patients with duplicate samples.\n")
    duplicate_inspection_table <- sample_metadata_table %>%
      filter(patient %in% duplicated_patient_ids) %>%
      arrange(patient, sample_vial, desc(library_size))
    print(duplicate_inspection_table[, c("patient", "barcode", "sample_vial",
                                         "portion", "plate", "library_size")])
  } else {
    cat("No duplicate patients found in", tissue_label, "\n")
  }

  # Sort by patient, lowest vial, highest library size, and keep the first occurrence
  deduplicated_metadata_table <- sample_metadata_table %>%
    arrange(patient, sample_vial, desc(library_size)) %>%
    filter(!duplicated(patient))

  deduplicated_expression_matrix <-
    expression_matrix[, deduplicated_metadata_table$barcode, drop = FALSE]

  cat("Samples before:", ncol(expression_matrix),
      "| after deduplication:", ncol(deduplicated_expression_matrix), "\n")

  list(
    clean_expression_matrix = deduplicated_expression_matrix,
    clean_sample_metadata   = deduplicated_metadata_table
  )
}



# Deduplicate each tissue
cancer_deduplicated_tcga_expression <- deduplicate_tcga_expression_matrix(
  expression_matrix = cancer_expression_common_genes,
  tissue_label      = "Cancer Tissue",
  condition_label   = "cancer"
)

normal_deduplicated_tcga_expression <- deduplicate_tcga_expression_matrix(
  expression_matrix = normal_expression_common_genes,
  tissue_label      = "Normal Tissue",
  condition_label   = "normal"
)
```



## Matched (Paired) Patients

We keep only patients with both a tumor and a normal sample. Each patient serves as their own control (paired design).

Normal samples are the limiting factor. All 52 normal patients also have a tumor sample -> 52 matched pairs.

```{r match_filter_pairs}
cancer_sample_metadata <- cancer_deduplicated_tcga_expression$clean_sample_metadata
normal_sample_metadata <- normal_deduplicated_tcga_expression$clean_sample_metadata

common_patient_barcodes <- intersect(cancer_sample_metadata$patient,
                                     normal_sample_metadata$patient)

cat("Unique tumor patients :", nrow(cancer_sample_metadata), "\n")
cat("Unique normal patients:", nrow(normal_sample_metadata), "\n")
cat("Matched patients      :", length(common_patient_barcodes), "\n")

cancer_paired_metadata <- cancer_sample_metadata %>%
  filter(patient %in% common_patient_barcodes)
normal_paired_metadata <- normal_sample_metadata %>%
  filter(patient %in% common_patient_barcodes)

cancerTissue_geneExpression_cleanMatrix <-
  cancer_deduplicated_tcga_expression$clean_expression_matrix[
    , cancer_paired_metadata$barcode, drop = FALSE]
normalTissue_geneExpression_cleanMatrix <-
  normal_deduplicated_tcga_expression$clean_expression_matrix[
    , normal_paired_metadata$barcode, drop = FALSE]
```



## Patient Metadata Reference

The count matrix holds one column per sample (tissue specimen) with ~60,000 genes. The metadata table describes each sample (one row per sample) and is used later in the analysis.

Two sources are merged on the patient ID ("patient" = "submitter_id"):

- Technical metadata (from the barcode, per sample) = how the sample was processed
  - condition: "cancer" / "normal" (from sample type)
  - plate -> sequencing batch
  - vial, portion, library size
- Clinical metadata (from GDC clinical table, per patient) = who the patient is
  - age_at_index -> age at diagnosis
  - sex_at_birth

Confounders: age, plate, patient. They influence expression besides the condition. Including them in the model avoids spurious associations and increases statistical power.
Sex is excluded as PRAD is a prostate cancer cohort so every patient is male giving sex as constant.

Samples with missing confounder values are removed together with their pair.


```{r create_metadata_reference}
# Merge technical metadata (per sample) with clinical metadata (per patient)
# many-to-one: stops if a patient has several clinical rows
build_sample_metadata <- function(technical_metadata, clinical_metadata) {
  technical_metadata %>%
    left_join(clinical_metadata, by = "patient", relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
    select(-any_of("myorder")) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("barcode")
}

# Missing values per study variable
print_missing_value_summary <- function(sample_metadata) {
  is_na <- is.na(sample_metadata[, required_study_columns])
  data.frame(missing = colSums(is_na), percent = round(100 * colMeans(is_na), 1))
}


# Declared confounders
target_confounder_columns <- c("age_at_index", "sex_at_birth", "plate", "patient")


# Clinical data (per patient)
# recent GDC releases use "sex_at_birth" while older ones were "gender"
sex_column_name <- intersect(c("sex_at_birth", "gender"), colnames(clinical_patient_data))[1]

selected_clinical_metadata <- clinical_patient_data %>%
  select(patient = submitter_id, age_at_index, sex_at_birth = all_of(sex_column_name)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character),
                ~ replace(., tolower(trimws(.)) %in% c("not reported", "unknown", ""), NA)))


# Whole metadata = technical + clinical
paired_patient_metadata <- build_sample_metadata(
  bind_rows(cancer_paired_metadata, normal_paired_metadata),
  selected_clinical_metadata
)


# Drop constant confounders (e.g. sex in PRAD: all male)
is_constant <- sapply(target_confounder_columns, function(col)
  n_distinct(paired_patient_metadata[[col]], na.rm = TRUE) < 2)
cat("Dropped constant confounders:", target_confounder_columns[is_constant], "\n")

target_confounder_columns <- target_confounder_columns[!is_constant]
required_study_columns    <- c(target_confounder_columns, "condition")


# Missing values -> drop the whole pair if one sample is incomplete
print_missing_value_summary(paired_patient_metadata)

incomplete <- !complete.cases(paired_patient_metadata[, required_study_columns])
patients_to_remove <- unique(paired_patient_metadata$patient[incomplete])
paired_patient_metadata <-
  paired_patient_metadata[!paired_patient_metadata$patient %in% patients_to_remove, ]

cat("Removed patients (missing data):", length(patients_to_remove), "\n")
cat("Paired samples:", nrow(paired_patient_metadata),
    "| patients:", n_distinct(paired_patient_metadata$patient), "\n")
```


## Format Variables

```{r format_variables}
format_sample_metadata <- function(sample_metadata) {
  sample_metadata$condition    <- factor(sample_metadata$condition,
                                         levels = c("normal", "cancer"))  # normal = reference
  sample_metadata$sex_at_birth <- factor(sample_metadata$sex_at_birth)
  sample_metadata$plate        <- factor(sample_metadata$plate)
  sample_metadata$patient      <- factor(sample_metadata$patient)
  # Center and scale age (mean = 0, SD = 1) for numerical stability in GLMs
  sample_metadata$scaled_age   <- as.numeric(scale(sample_metadata$age_at_index))
  sample_metadata
}

paired_patient_metadata <- format_sample_metadata(paired_patient_metadata)

# Sex: documented, but only used as confounder if not constant (see above)
table(paired_patient_metadata$sex_at_birth, useNA = "ifany")

# Plate vs condition: a plate that contains only one condition is confounded with it
table(paired_patient_metadata$plate, paired_patient_metadata$condition)
summary(paired_patient_metadata$age_at_index)
```



## Align Count Matrix and Metadata

The count matrix columns must be in exactly the same order as the metadata rows.

```{r align}
combined_expression_matrix <- cbind(
  cancerTissue_geneExpression_cleanMatrix,
  normalTissue_geneExpression_cleanMatrix
)

valid_sample_barcodes      <- rownames(paired_patient_metadata)
paired_counts_matrix       <- combined_expression_matrix[, valid_sample_barcodes, drop = FALSE]
paired_patient_metadata    <- paired_patient_metadata[valid_sample_barcodes, , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(paired_counts_matrix), rownames(paired_patient_metadata)))

dim(paired_counts_matrix)
table(paired_patient_metadata$condition)
```


## Full Tumor Cohort Metadata

For tumor-only analyses we also build the metadata for all deduplicated tumor samples (paired or not).

```{r tumor_metadata}
tumor_patient_metadata <- build_sample_metadata(
  technical_metadata = cancer_sample_metadata,
  clinical_metadata  = selected_clinical_metadata
)
tumor_patient_metadata <- format_sample_metadata(tumor_patient_metadata)

tumor_counts_matrix <- cancer_deduplicated_tcga_expression$clean_expression_matrix[
  , rownames(tumor_patient_metadata), drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(tumor_counts_matrix), rownames(tumor_patient_metadata)))

cat("Tumor samples (all patients):", ncol(tumor_counts_matrix), "\n")
print_missing_value_summary(tumor_patient_metadata)
```


## Save Data

Saved as `SummarizedExperiment` (.rds): counts, sample metadata and gene annotation
in one object, with sample alignment checked on creation.

- paired cohort: 52 tumor-normal pairs (104 samples)
- tumor cohort: all 497 deduplicated tumor samples
- full GDC clinical table

```{r save_prepared_data}
paired_se <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(
  assays  = list(counts = paired_counts_matrix),
  colData = paired_patient_metadata,
  rowData = gene_annotation[rownames(paired_counts_matrix), , drop = FALSE]
)

tumor_se <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(
  assays  = list(counts = tumor_counts_matrix),
  colData = tumor_patient_metadata,
  rowData = gene_annotation[rownames(tumor_counts_matrix), , drop = FALSE]
)

saveRDS(paired_se, file.path(data_dir, paste0(project_specifier, "_paired_se.rds")))
saveRDS(tumor_se,  file.path(data_dir, paste0(project_specifier, "_tumor_se.rds")))
saveRDS(clinical_patient_data,
        file.path(data_dir, paste0(project_specifier, "_clinical.rds")))


# Optional CSV export (e.g. for Python / Excel)
export_csv <- FALSE
if (export_csv) {
  write.csv(paired_patient_metadata,
            file.path(data_dir, paste0(project_specifier, "_paired_metadata.csv")))
  write.csv(paired_counts_matrix,
            gzfile(file.path(data_dir, paste0(project_specifier, "_paired_counts.csv.gz"))))
  write.csv(tumor_patient_metadata,
            file.path(data_dir, paste0(project_specifier, "_tumor_metadata.csv")))
  write.csv(tumor_counts_matrix,
            gzfile(file.path(data_dir, paste0(project_specifier, "_tumor_counts.csv.gz"))))
}
```
